description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ClusterStatusStage' that creates an Akka stream graph stage for processing cluster status information. It retrieves the cluster status, checks for reachability and presence of expected roles, and outputs either the total number of instances or a credit rejection decision based on health checks.

classes.name: ClusterStatusStage
classes.description: Final utility class providing a static method to create an Akka stream stage that outputs cluster status health checks and counts based on reachability and roles.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a graph stage that when triggered, evaluates cluster status and outputs either the total count of expected role instances or a credit rejection decision depending on cluster health.

methods.name: getPersistenceInstances
methods.description: Evaluates cluster status and returns either a rejection decision if cluster is unhealthy or the total count of reachable role instances.

methods.name: areAllMembersReachable
methods.description: Checks if all cluster members are reachable based on the cluster status.

methods.name: countMembersOfExpectedRoles
methods.description: Counts the number of reachable members for each expected role; returns total count if all are present, otherwise returns a rejection decision.
